login.lede: With Google, GitHub or a 6-digit code sent to your email. If it is your first time, your account is created.

signUp.lede: There is no password to remember: you sign in with Google, GitHub or a 6-digit code by email.

email.label: Email
email.help: We send you a 6-digit code. No password needed.

code.lede: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in a few minutes.
code.label: 6-digit code
code.help: If you do not see it, check your spam folder.
code.otherEmail: Use another email or ask for a new code
code.missingEmail: We do not know which email to send the code to. Start again.

errors.captcha: We could not check that you are a person. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: You have asked for too many codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Check the 6 digits or ask for a new one.
errors.callback: We could not complete the sign-in. Please try again.

auth.legal: By continuing you accept the <notice>legal notice</notice> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

profile.lede: What we call you, which language we write in and how you protect access.

account.title: Account
account.emailHelp: It is your sign-in identifier and cannot be changed here.

form.title: Preferences
form.displayNameHelp: It appears on your comments. You can leave it empty.
form.invalid: Check the data: the name allows up to 80 characters.
form.failed: We could not save the changes. Please try again.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.required: Your account is an admin account: to enter the panel you need to verify a code from your authenticator app.
security.lede: Add an authenticator app (TOTP) as a second factor.
security.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app or enter this key by hand:
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.challenge: Enter the current code from your authenticator app to continue.
security.removeHelp: It can only be removed from an already verified session.
security.invalidCode: The code is wrong. Check your device clock and try again.
security.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
security.failed: We could not complete the operation. Please try again.
